about_the_game:
Vicarius is a small handcrafted open world focused on exploration and combat. Leave your safe zone to gather the resources that will help you craft better gear. The further you go, the more dangerous it gets but the resources are also better. Dying means losing everything that you are carrying.

In this Action-Adventure game, you ascend into a world you know nothing about. You won't be handheld in any way. No tutorial. No direction. No map. No goal given. Minimal user interface. Figure it out or stay stuck. 


This game isn't for everyone. It doesn't try to be. It is difficult. And there is no option to make it easier. If you are looking for a game that will hold your hand all the way until the finish line then this game isn't for you. And it's okay. I'm sure you'll find something else.

FEATURES

  •  Explore a seamless handcrafted open world with different biomes.

  •  Discover a wide variety of enemies each with unique abilities.

  •  Understand the mechanics that will help you progress.

  •  Gather the resources you'll need to craft your gear.

  • Customize your loadout by choosing between different weapons and abilities.

  • Get back alive to the safe zone to not lose your gear and loot.

  • Exterminate what stands between you and the answers you are looking for.

  • FIGURE IT OUT OR STAY STUCK.

EXPLORE. UNDERSTAND. EXTERMINATE.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game includes humanoid, animal and monster blood and corpses.
Also, the game is centered around combat. So the violence is a main part of the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 3 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1 GB video memory
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 3.7 GHz 6-Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1 GB video memory
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game is CPU heavy. The faster the CPU speed, the better.
